jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
A leading media and technology company is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join their team. They operate a powerful product discovery platform that connects shoppers with desired products from thousands of retail partners, creating deeply personalized shopping experiences by leveraging user-saved, organized, and shared product data.

The Role

Partner with engineers across data, web, and mobile to build and evolve foundational services.
Design and implement new services, APIs, and operational monitoring functions.
Own production services end-to-end, investigating issues, resolving bottlenecks, and identifying improvements.
Lead code reviews, mentor engineers, and advocate for best practices.
Drive identification and prioritization of technical debt.
Provide thorough, readable documentation for owned services.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or relevant experience.
5+ years of relevant professional technology experience.
Deep understanding of REST, service architecture, monitoring, and horizontal scalability.
Experience developing complex, highly available services in a production environment.
Extensive knowledge of object-oriented and functional software design patterns.
Proven experience owning production services deployed in AWS or Google Cloud Platform, leveraging containers and CI.
Extensive experience using Node.js, TypeScript, and NestJS, with some Java and GraphQL knowledge.

What's On Offer

Opportunity to work on a next-generation product discovery platform.
Chance to mentor other engineers and shape technical direction.
Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, unlimited PTO, and 401K with company match.
Collaborative and agile work environment.

Apply via Haystack today!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role
• Develop innovative solutions for national security challenges, focusing on cyber operations, special operations, and global health.
• Build scalable data pipelines and tailored analytics for new domains, including the deployment and adaptation of generative AI.
• Apply strong engineering practices for architectural design, testability, scalability, and maintainability.
• Own high-quality code across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements to deployment and sustainment.
• Integrate AI-assisted development into team workflows and contribute to the assurance of AI/ML solutions.

What You'll Need
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field, with relevant experience.
• At least 5 years of software development and engineering experience.
• Extensive programming experience in Python, Javascript, Java, Kotlin, or C++.
• Proven ability to lead teams through the full software development lifecycle.
• Experience with Git, Gitlab Continuous Integration and Deployment, or equivalent version control and CI/CD systems.
• Ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance.

What's On Offer
• Competitive annual salary ($105,000 - $290,000) plus potential for bonuses and other compensation.
• Opportunity to work on impactful projects addressing critical national security challenges.
• A collaborative and creative work environment that prioritizes innovation and personal development.
• Comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, and education assistance.

Apply via Haystack today!
